Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.wmtslayer

Class PublishWmtsLayerRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.wmtslayer.PublishWmtsLayerRequest
public class PublishWmtsLayerRequest extends Object
Request DTO for publishing a WMTS (cascading) layer.

Builds the request body for POST /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmtsstores/{store}/layers.

Required fields

  • name — local layer name to publish
  • nativeName — layer name as it appears in the remote WMTS GetCapabilities (e.g. "ws:layerName")
